author: Beatrix Potter
title: The Tale of Timmy Tiptoes
edition: Project Gutenberg 14797 transcription of Frederick Warne & Co., Inc., New York text, copyright 1911 (printed by Princeton Polychrome Press; printing undated). Every selected paragraph was compared with OCR of a library copy whose title page reads London, Frederick Warne and Co., and New York, 1911 (Internet Archive TheTaleofTimmyTiptoes, Google-digitized); no wording differences were found. Narrative only; illustrations, publisher and digitizer matter excluded. Prose line wrapping joined; paragraph and verse boundaries, punctuation, spelling and plain-text emphasis markers (underscores) retained. The library text holds the whole tale: its title as a heading, the author’s dedication as set lines, and every paragraph of the narrative; the title, copyright and printer’s pages, illustrations and “THE END” are omitted.

rights.basis: Potter’s original English narrative was published in 1911, before 1931; its US publication term has expired as of 2026. Project Gutenberg identifies this English text as public domain in the USA. No modern introduction, illustration, or new editorial matter is reproduced.

acquisition.method: Project Gutenberg plain text (pg14797.txt from the aleph.pglaf.org mirror) with the PG header, footer, licence and any transcriber’s or production notes removed; [Illustration] placeholders, the title, copyright and printer’s pages and “THE END” omitted. The tale’s title became a level-1 heading and the dedication one stanza keeping its printed line breaks; every flush-left blank-line separated group became a paragraph with wrapped lines joined by single spaces, and indented verse groups became stanzas with leading indentation removed. Underscore italics and double-hyphen dashes kept as transcribed. Every Kindergarten night from this tale was located block for block.
